description: CRITICAL ERROR: L1/L2 agents must not ask customers for unnecessary or irrelevant information not required for handling the issue.
Before escalating to L3, the agent must collect mandatory information (Booking Reference, Name, Flight details) and document a clear summary in the CRM.
If a customer reports delayed baggage but left the airport without a PIR, the agent must advise that a PIR is mandatory and claims cannot be processed without one. Do not process the claim.
Agent must explicitly state if the ticket is refundable or non-refundable before canceling.
If non-refundable, agent must offer future travel credit. Cash refunds must not be offered.
Agent must advise the flyer of the timeline for processing the cancellation/credit.
Agent must verify the booking source (Direct vs. Third-party) before processing refund requests.
Agent must explain refund eligibility based on fare type (Flex vs. Non-refundable).
Agent must provide the estimated processing time for the refund upon request.
Agents are not authorized to approve hotel accommodations or EU261 compensation. Escalate to L3.
If a payment was deducted but no booking exists, agents must not confirm payment receipt or promise a refund. Collect transaction details and escalate to L3.
